videos.title: As Good as Dead
videos.description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

videos.title: Falcon Rising
videos.description: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

videos.title: Triple Threat
videos.description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

videos.title: The Island
videos.description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

videos.title: Shottas
videos.description: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

videos.title: Christmas in Compton
videos.description: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

videos.title: A Family Matters Christmas
videos.description: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

videos.title: My One Christmas Wish
videos.description: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

videos.title: The Best of Enemies
videos.description: During the racially charged summer of 1971, outspoken civil rights activist Ann Atwater and local Ku Klux Klan leader C.P. videos.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
videos.description: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

videos.title: Medusa Deluxe
videos.description: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
videos.description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
videos.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
videos.description: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
videos.description: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
videos.description: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

videos.title: My One Christmas Wish
videos.description: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

videos.title: Hope Street Holiday
videos.description: Afro-Latina attorney Galia Garcia returns to her small hometown after being dumped days before Christmas. With some help, Galia heals from past trauma, rediscovers her self-worth and falls in love all over again.","large":"Afro-Latina attorney Galia Garcia returns to her small hometown after being dumped days before Christmas. With the help of a 5-year-old orphan, her crazy aunties and the magic of the season, Galia heals from past trauma, rediscovers her self-worth and falls in love all over again.

videos.title: Christmas in Compton
videos.description: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

videos.title: Greyson Family Christmas
videos.description: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.
